title: When a payment, sale or new member fails to save, MettleUp never hears of it
what: Every desk form (collect payment, sell or renew, add or edit member, freeze, change start date, cancel receipt) catches a failed save and shows the desk a message such as Please try again. The failure is never sent anywhere. The crash reports only cover errors nobody caught. So a gym whose payments keep failing is invisible to you until the owner complains, and then there is no record of what went wrong. The message also gives the desk no way to reach help.
expected: A failed money or member save is reported to MettleUp (no personal data), and the message tells the desk where to get help if trying again does not work.
fix_line: Send each failed desk save to the existing crash report, and add a help line to the failure message

title: Several desk tasks have no help answer, and the help check never looks at these forms
what: The help library has no answer for changing a future start date, taking part payment at a sale, selling a personal training pack with the plan, the front desk money limits (10% off, payment date 31 days back) or taking payments with no internet. The help check only looks at full screens, never at these pop-up forms, so a new or changed form never asks for help words.
expected: Each desk form task has a help answer, and the help check covers the forms too.
fix_line: Write the missing help answers and make the help check include the forms folder

title: Help says a cancelled receipt always goes back onto the member's dues
what: The help answer says the amount of a cancelled receipt goes back into the member's dues. The form itself knows that when the plan was cancelled, nothing goes back onto the dues. An owner following the help waits for a due that never shows.
expected: Help says the amount goes back onto the dues unless the plan was cancelled.
how_often: each receipt cancelled on a cancelled plan
fix_line: Add the cancelled-plan exception to the help answer

items.reason: these forms hold no account, domain, key or token; the payment company keys are typed in Settings, another area
